recipes.name: Chickpea Brownie Batter
ingredients: ¼ cup sweetened condensed coconut milk
instructions: In a food processor, combine the chickpeas, nut butter, condensed coconut milk, cocoa powder, milk, vanilla, and salt.
Blend until completely smooth. For the best texture, it’s better to slightly over-blend than under-blend.
Taste and add more peanut butter if you'd like a richer mouthfeel, or more sweetened condensed coconut milk if you'd like it sweeter. Remove the blades and fold in the chocolate.
Enjoy right away or chill briefly for a firmer, fudgier texture. Top with more chopped chocolate if desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use 50 - 60% cacao chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. The batter firms up when chilled; let it sit at room temperature for a few minutes before serving.
